prompt.sw: Karatasi nyeupe ya Bitcoin iliandikwa na nani?
Ni kipi kati ya hivi unaweza kushiriki kwa usalama?
prompt.en: Which of these can you share safely?

explanation.sw: Anwani ni ya kupokea pesa. Maneno ya siri na ufunguo binafsi ni siri milele.
explanation.en: An address is for receiving money. Seed phrases and private keys stay secret forever.

prompt.sw: Ukibadilisha simu, unahamishaje alama zako za maendeleo ya Jifunze?
prompt.en: If you change phones, how do you move your Jifunze progress ticks?

label.en: They move automatically to your account

label.sw: Pakua faili ya maendeleo, kisha ilete kwenye simu mpya
label.en: Download the progress file, then import it on the new phone

explanation.sw: Jifunze haina akaunti; maendeleo yako yako kwenye kifaa chako tu.
explanation.en: Jifunze has no accounts; your progress lives only on your device.

prompt.sw: Njia bora ya kukumbuka ulichojifunza ni ipi?
prompt.en: What is the best way to remember what you learned?

label.sw: Kupiga picha ya maneno yako ya siri

explanation.sw: Ukiweza kueleza wazo kwa maneno yako, umelielewa.
explanation.en: If you can explain an idea in your own words, you understand it.
